title: Word-by-Word Story · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Word-by-Word Story · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a simple topic. The pair alternates one word at a time to make a complete sentence about the topic. The sentence is understandable and contains at least six words. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Word-by-Word Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The sentence is understandable and contains at least six words.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The sentence is understandable and contains at least six words.
